verdicts.reason: A keeps the circle-and-can illustration intact and the same design identity. The CTA is large and clear and the headline dominates. Flaws: GLACIER is centered oddly over the headline instead of aligned with it, the badges and CTA form a cramped right column with a big gap before it, the can is small, and the badge text is tiny. B separates the can from its circle: the circle is empty on the left and the can floats on the far right, which breaks the key imagery. B also puts the brand name below the headline, so the reading order is wrong, and the CTA is a small button no bigger than the badges. The body and badge text are tiny, and the text block is crammed against the bottom edge with a wide dead gap on the right.
